tasks.label: Package corrected NEXUS OS ZIP
tasks.command: $src='C:\Users\samue\Downloads\NEXUS_OS_FASE_1\nexus-os'; $stage='C:\Users\samue\Downloads\NEXUS_OS_FASE_1\nexus-os-package-staging'; $zip='C:\Users\samue\Downloads\NEXUS_OS_FASE_1\NEXUS_OS_FASE_1_CORRIGIDA.zip'; Remove-Item $stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item $zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stage | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem $src -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin @('node_modules','.next','dist','coverage') } | Copy-Item -Destination $stage -Recurse -Force; Get-ChildItem $stage -Recurse -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('node_modules','.next','dist','coverage') -or $_.Name -like '.env' -or $_.Name -like '.env.*' } | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Compress-Archive -Path ($stage + '\*') -DestinationPath $zip -CompressionLevel Optimal; Remove-Item $stage -Recurse -Force; Write-Output $zip
